description: Java Spring Boot controller class handling user profile and authentication-related endpoints.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Controller managing user profile viewing and editing, with security role restrictions.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve and display the current user's profile and enrolled courses.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve user data for editing, with authentication check.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to update user information after authentication verification.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to partially update user details after authentication verification.
